import pandas as pd, re
def prep(f,out):
    df=pd.read_parquet(f)
    with open(out,'w') as fo:
        for l,t in zip(df['label'],df['text']):
            t=t.replace('\\\\n',' ').replace('\n',' ')
            t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip().lower()
            fo.write(f'__label__{l} {t}\n')
prep('data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet','train.txt')
prep('data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet','test.txt')
print('done')
" && wc -l train.txt test.txt && head -c 200 train.txt

import pandas as pd, re
def norm(t):
    t=t.replace('\\\\n',' ').replace('\n',' ').replace('\\\\\"','')
    t=t.replace(chr(34),'')
    t=t.replace(\"'\",\" ' \")
    for p in ['.',',','(',')','!','?']:
        t=t.replace(p,' '+p+' ')
    t=t.replace(';',' ').replace(':',' ')
    t=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip().lower()
    return t
def prep(f,out):
    df=pd.read_parquet(f)
    with open(out,'w') as fo:
        for l,t in zip(df['label'],df['text']):
            fo.write('__label__%d %s\n'%(l,norm(t)))
prep('data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet','train.txt')
prep('data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet','test.txt')
print('done')
"; head -c 200 train.txt
